messages:
Lina CS: @channel quick pulse — onboarding latency spike this morning affected a rolling set of new tenants (ingest & embed paths). We're prepping customer comms. TL;DR: root cause = a cache invalidation race during a deploy, mitigation = rollback + hotfix.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-4790012345 created by deploy-watch — severity: P2 — affected: 34 onboarding tenants.
Maya CS: Rough ETA on the full fix + rollback confirmation for customers?
Derek Eng: rollback completed at 08:12 UTC, hotfix deployed at 08:40. We saw 90% reduction in latency; we're monitoring for 2 hours.
Lina CS: thanks — propose customer-first comms this cadence: 1) immediate update, 2) post-mitigations + ETA, 3) RCA + credit. Thoughts?
Kyra PM: agree. Add an invite for enablement office hours this week for affected onboarding teams — this reduces churn risk.
Alberto Rev: heads-up — several customers in renewal window flagged. If we offer 2 weeks of elevated support + onboarding session, can we avoid escalations?
Tom Eng: we can offer a dedicated session with eng and CS for 10 priority accounts. Need to confirm availability Tue/Thu 15:00 UTC.
Maya CS: drafting outbound now. Sharing template below — will personalize per account.
Maya CS: ```
Hi <Customer>,
We wanted to let you know about a temporary onboarding delay you may have observed today. We've identified the cause and rolled out a mitigation. Next steps: (1) we restored normal performance; (2) we invite you to a troubleshooting session; (3) we will follow up with an RCA and credits.
Would you like the enablement session this Tue or Thu at 15:00 UTC? Reply with a preference.
Regards,
<Name> — Customer Success
```
Derek Eng: small note for the template — please avoid technical jargon. Replace 'mitigation' with 'temporary fix' and remove internal timings.
Maya CS: updated.
Lina CS: Also include survey link at the end to capture impact & sentiment: https://redwood.internal/surveys/onboard-impact — 3 questions, 30s to complete.
Alberto Rev: I'll offer credits proactively for 5 renewal-risk accounts. Can CS share a prioritized list?
Maya CS: creating list now — pushing to shared doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/onboard-affected-4790012345
Tom Eng: for the office hours script, here's a short checklist engineers should follow:
```
- confirm tenant ingest health
- validate embeddings latency (p90/p99)
- check cache warm status
- share remediation steps
```
Kyra PM: We'll coordinate messaging in the Console 'Status' banner too — draft coming.
Lina CS: action items: @Maya compile personalized notes + send emails by 10:30 UTC; @Tom confirm eng attendee roster by EOD; @Alberto list top 5 renewal accounts by 12:00 UTC; @Kyra draft Console banner. I'll coordinate office hours invites.
Maya CS: copying draft to Sales/AMs for personalization. Ping me if an account needs bespoke handling.
Derek Eng: monitoring graphs look stable; will post a follow-up at +90 min.
incident-bot: Update 09:15 UTC — latency metrics back to baseline; no new errors reported.
Lina CS: thanks team. Quick question — do we want to proactively offer a one-on-one migration review to all affected onboarding customers? Might reduce churn.
Alberto Rev: yes for the ones flagged as renewal risk; for others, offer office hours opt-in.
Maya CS: sending first tranche of emails now (10 accounts). Will report opens + replies in thread.
Tom Eng: available Tue/Thu 15:00 UTC — marking calendar.
Maya CS: first reply received: "Thu preferred, appreciate the proactive outreach" — account: tiny-retailer-prod
Lina CS: good. keep these replies in the doc. After RCA is finalized, we'll send formal vendor-grade RCAs to enterprise accounts.
Kyra PM: RCA draft due EOD — include timeline, root cause, corrective actions, and preventative controls.
Derek Eng: adding follow-up item: add automated cache warm on deploy to prevent race; ticket created: CO-3912.
Lina CS: capturing feedback loop: post-office-hours we'll run a 2-question NPS follow-up (link above) and escalate any account that reports 'very dissatisfied'.
Maya CS: thanks — will track in the spreadsheet and tag Sales for churn signals.
Lina CS: great work everyone. I'll ship the immediate update in 15 and tag execs for visibility. :thumbsup:
Maya CS: :thumbsup: sending now.
